source_row.stem: A laboratory specimen collected from a client requires:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A biohazard label/symbol, per OSHA regulations, since all specimens are treated as potentially infectious","B":"No specific labeling requirement at all, regardless of what the specimen is ultimately used for","C":"A label required only for specimens being sent for formal research purposes rather than routine clinical testing","D":"A label required only when the client has an already-documented, known infectious diagnosis"}}
source_row.rationale: OSHA regulations require biohazard labeling on laboratory specimens, since all blood and body fluid specimens are treated as potentially infectious regardless of known client infection status.
source_row.source_name: OSHA — Bloodborne Pathogens Standard, Labeling Requirements
